package.author: Traycer AI, Inc.

en-US.author: Traycer AI, Inc.
en-US.longDescription: Traycer is a shared workspace — the nerve center for agentic coding. Run multiple AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Cursor) side by side and let them communicate with each other while sharing files, artifacts, and history. Built-in skills cover plan, execute, review, and explain, and multiplayer collaboration lets your team work in the same workspace.
en-US.name: Traycer
en-US.releaseNotes:
What's Changed
- fix(gui-app): a reading position saved inside a turn survives the steer that splits it (#3262) (6fc31b4)
- fix(gui-app,desktop): mod+w in a sandboxed page closes its tile, not the task tab (#3263) (757d0eb)
- fix(gui-app): a steer-split restore saves its resolved slice at mount, not only after it validates (#3276) (81807ff)
- fix(gui-app): the usage popover's selected provider tab is visible on dark presets (#3267) (1f72e83)
- perf(gui): expand a sidebar branch without re-rendering every row (#3275) (f79760d)
- fix(gui-app): a press inside a sandboxed artifact page closes the status-bar popovers (#3277) (63b8dfa)
- fix(gui-app): the epic-create seed hold reads the opening's delivery state (#3278) (2b81f0b)
- fix(gui-app): preserve board iframe focus during relayed presses (#3290) (1b89af3)
- fix(gui-app): skip the notification indicator read for a dead host (#3292) (7d70a09)
- fix(gui-app): a press inside a browser tile closes the status-bar popovers (#3286) (403fc38)
- fix(gui-app): Ctrl/⌘ pressed while a scroll coasts no longer zooms the PDF and Word previews (#3302) (6476c5d)
- test(gui-app): account for wheel zoom modifier reads (#3305) (5007f23)
- fix(desktop): keep a stall's evidence in the report past the 500-line tail (#3309) (84fbb98)
- fix(browser): draw a parked browser guest only while main reads it (#3316) (4b0d698)
- fix(gui-app): a covered macOS window keeps its tasks resident (#3318) (513fefa)
- fix(gui-app): the Providers card says what happened instead of asking for a host update (#3311) (da1f617)
- fix(gui): an open changeset panel keeps its rows while a turn streams (#3320) (79c596b)
- fix(gui): a report from a persisted agent error row carries the row's Host time and turn (#3336) (54eb4ee)
- fix(gui-app): an HTML artifact page opens below its controls, which shrink to a corner chip (#3303) (0261390)
- feat(protocol,cli): record how the host ended, for an out-of-memory notice (#2366) (#3310) (ad45e2c)
- fix(protocol): name the shape found and the shape wanted in a foreign provider key refusal (#3037) (b07eb0d)
- fix(scripts): no early-exit reader reads a pipe under pipefail (#3337) (89f337e)
- test(gui-app): reconcile the release fixture for #3310 host.status (fa128aa)
- style(gui-app): format the #3275 release fixture (0ce0c51)
- fix(gui-app): keep #3303 controls on the release absolute layout (3b0179f)
Traycer Desktop 1.5.3.

zh-CN.longDescription: Traycer 是面向智能体编码的共享工作区 — 智能体编码的中枢。可以并排运行多个 AI 编码智能体（Claude Code、Codex、OpenCode、Cursor），让它们相互通信，同时共享文件、工件和历史记录。内置技能涵盖规划、执行、审查和讲解，多人协作让团队在同一个工作区中协同工作。
